description: Shared subscription cancellation wedge configuration. Defines the three-step email sequence structure, per-vertical templating, and common elements.

steps.name: Initial Cancellation Demand
steps.purpose: Clear cancellation demand citing applicable consumer protection rule

steps.name: Follow-Up
steps.purpose: Follow up on non-response, escalate tone slightly, reference original email

steps.name: Final Demand with Regulatory Reference
steps.purpose: Final demand explicitly referencing regulatory complaint and chargeback options

email_principles.notes: Unlike deposit letters, cancellation emails are written in first person ('I am requesting...') because they are direct communications from the consumer, not third-party-framed writing. The legal grounding is still descriptive ('Under the FTC's click-to-cancel rule...').
prohibited_phrases: I will take you to court
permitted_escalation_language: I intend to file a complaint with [specific agency]
I will dispute these charges with my financial institution
I am documenting this for a potential regulatory complaint

copy_paste.description: Default: user copies the email text and sends from their own email

send_on_behalf.description: Optional: user connects their email account and the tool sends on their behalf

common_cancellation_barriers.name: No online cancellation option
common_cancellation_barriers.description: Company requires phone call or in-person visit to cancel what was signed up for online

common_cancellation_barriers.name: Forced retention offers / dark patterns
common_cancellation_barriers.applicable_law: FTC Click-to-Cancel Rule; state UDAP statutes
common_cancellation_barriers.description: Company forces user through retention offers or multiple confirmation screens

common_cancellation_barriers.name: Auto-renewed without clear consent
common_cancellation_barriers.applicable_law: State auto-renewal laws (CA ARL, NY GBL §527-a); FTC Negative Option Rule
common_cancellation_barriers.description: Subscription auto-renewed without clear pre-renewal disclosure or affirmative consent

common_cancellation_barriers.name: Early termination fee
common_cancellation_barriers.applicable_law: Varies by state and contract type
common_cancellation_barriers.description: Company charges a fee for cancelling before contract end date

common_cancellation_barriers.name: Charges continue after cancellation
common_cancellation_barriers.applicable_law: State consumer protection; FCBA chargeback rights
common_cancellation_barriers.description: Company continues charging after cancellation was confirmed
